Name: Is That a Crab aka crab monsters recolor
Author: pmgin
Description:
[b][b]Have you ever had to kill 8 more rock crabs for Monster Eradication goal and after descending into the mine found out that spotting crabs is way too difficult? Well, no more![/b]

What does this mod do?[/b]
It replaces all monster crab variants with more saturated textures so you can tell them apart from regular stones. That includes: rock crabs, dangerous rock crabs, lava crabs, dangerous lava crabs, iridium crabs, truffle crabs & stick bugs.

This mod has a config file where you can disable each monster variant with [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10505]GMCM Options[/url][/b] or via file editing with a software such as Notepad++.

[b]Requirements[/b]
SMAPI + Content Patcher

[b]Compatibility[/b]
This mod has built-in compatibility with [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4366]6480's "Iridium Recolors" mod[/url][/b]﻿ and will automatically set an overlay texture for 6480's iridium crab edits. Works with both saturated and desaturated versions. You can choose between two overlay colors: orange and purple. Most of the color schemes from IR mod work the best with orange tint, but "forest" and "pearl" scheme crabs are more visible with purple overlay.

[b]Conflicts[/b]
Potentially any mod that changes crab monsters (other than Iridium Recolors). I set a high priority to my recolors, but I can't guarantee that thay will work properly in each case.

[b]How to install[/b]
Make sure that you installed SMAPI and Content Patcher. Download and unpack folder from "download" section.
Drop the mod folder to your "Mods" folder.
